observations: The page number «( 6 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L27-L28: «dece-|no (sic)»: the edition prints «deceno», divided at the end of L27, and marks the form with «(sic)» in italics; a reader has written an «s» in pencil between «no» and the bracket (see the copy matter), which makes it «decenos». The «s» is lighter than the print (its darkest pixels 90-140, where the letters of the line are darker than 90).

L12: «.xi.:» is a printed colon, to which a reader has added a tail in pencil below the lower dot (darkest pixel 87); the semicolons of L02, L06, L18, L24, L27 and L28 are printed (darkest pixel of the tail 46 to 70).

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): without a space after the mark, L06 «tercia,que» (4 px) and «.ix.;et» (11 px, the median word space of the line 17 px), L15 «numerum,et» (9 px, median 17 px), L09 «.x.,et» (5 px), L13 «differentiam,ubi» (6 px), L20 «lige.Si» (9 px, median 14) and «differentia,de» (7 px); with a space before the mark, L02 «tercia ;» (18 px), L08 «.ix. ,» (21 px) and «.x. :» (11 px), L14 «differentia :» (10 px), L17 «.x. ,» (20 px) and L27 «unitates ;» (12 px). L12 «.xi.:» and L18 «.xx.,» have 8 px before the mark, without a space.
